sanskrit_verse:
बालश्रोत्रियवित्ते च प्राप्ते च पितृतः क्रमात् ।
नोपभोगे बलं कार्यमाहर्त्रा तत्सुतेन वा ॥
transliteration: bālaśrotriyavitte ca prāpte ca pitṛtaḥ kramāt | nopabhoge balaṃ kāryam āhartrā tatsutena vā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When wealth belongs to a minor, a scholar, or a Brahmin, or has been received in accordance with paternal succession, its unauthorized consumption constitutes a violation of dharma, and force must not be applied by the taker or his son.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from rightful ownership, not physical possession
Causation arises through conscious misalignment with succession laws
Capacity-based responsibility applies to both the actor and progeny
Restoration logic requires return of unlawfully taken resources
Consciousness alignment demands recognition of dharmic entitlement structures
executable_legal_axioms: IF asset_owner.category IN [minor, brahmin, scholar] AND asset_transfer.method != lawful_succession THEN action.permitted = false
IF actor.role IN [taker, taker_descendant] AND resource.origin = protected_class THEN enforce_return_protocol.activate = true
IF claim.source != patrilineal_succession AND claimant NOT authorized_by_dharma THEN access.granted = false FOR all_assets
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving inheritance or unauthorized use of assets belonging to minors, scholars, or those under sacred protection, the Supreme Court must prioritize dharmic succession over civil title. Forceful acquisition or exploitation by the offender or their lineage is categorically barred, and restitution is mandated without punitive overlay.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that ownership inheres in the entitled category, not the possessor. Anupūrvaśaḥ indicates that misuse disrupts sequential harmony of succession. Proportional responsibility lies with the violator and extends to descendants who continue the breach. Non-punitive reality rule ensures correction through awareness and realignment rather than suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate property return protocol aligned with dharmic succession mapping
Activate consciousness reintegration process for violator and lineage
Restore energetic balance between parties via Vedic completion rituals
Realign societal memory to reflect true ownership without shame or blame
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this ruling restores Dharma. The taker and his lineage are called to awaken from error. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
